title: Spawntrapped
description: This is a survival Minecraft server. The server has griefing and pvp. The world started in 2010 and will never be reset. Hacks are not allowed. Join with spawntrapped.org
body:
This is a survival Minecraft server. The server has griefing and pvp The world will never be reset. Cheats, such as hacking and duplicating items, are not allowed.

Discord: https://discord.gg/u4GkTUXajn

Java Server IP: spawntrapped.org

Bedrock Server IP: bedrock.spawntrapped.org

Website: spawntrapped.org

Features:

We have a custom coded plugin that allows you to make portals to teleport to your base. This is a gameplay-based /home alternative that keeps travel meaningful.

2010 world, no resets ever

Griefing is allowed

PvP is allowed

No clingy admins that follow you around everywhere
